title: Quoting Armin Ronacher
summary: As fun as AI is, we built so much bad software over the last 30 years, and now the universe is punishing us for our sins. — Armin Ronacher Tags: security , generative-ai , armin-ronacher , ai , ai-security-research , llms

# Simon Willison’s Weblog

As fun as AI is, we built so much bad software over the last 30 years, and now the universe is punishing us for our sins.

Posted 22nd October 2026 at 3:34 pm

Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer - 20th October 2026 Hello Python 3.15, goodbye 3.10, and now I can use 3.11 - 12th October 2026 A new feature for my blog, built using my voice - 9th October 2026 Claude Haiku 5.5 - 7th October 2026
